annotation_description: Playing Steam Vents over Mountain when Mountain provides identical color access. Steam Vents either costs 2 life to enter untapped or enters tapped. Since they already have an Island to enable Riverpyre Verge, the dual land type provides negligible benefit over a basic Mountain. Playing Mountain would preserve the option to hold up Torch the Tower with untapped mana and save Steam Vents for a turn where they might need flexible mana.
